query: What happens when Samsung Galaxy Note 8 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: In fairness to the seller, they did issue refund. I always like to pass along to fellow buyers if the sellers stand by their product. Keep this in mind if you opt to purchase, and weigh your purchase accordingly.

Good phone(bad seller). So I like the phone, but my screen has a dent in it, fingerprint scanner will not work, and there are scratches on the bottom. I have contacted the seller will update with new info. The phone itself is great

Contact the seller first if you have an issue.. I've bought this phone twice. My first once lasted a few years but from me dropping it constantly, even in a case, I damaged it enough to need to buy a new one. The 2nd phone came and I was convinced it wasn't unlocked because it wouldn't work with straight talk. I requested a return and the seller contacted me to see if there was anything they could do to fix the issue AND THEY FIXED IT. Turns out it needed an update and that was it. If it doesn't seem to work, contact seller, their customer service is amazing.
The customer service agent whom helped me told me that my phone should have one year of manufacture warranty that the extended warranty I bought is after the one year manufacture warranty expires.

Faulty after 4 months. The phone works when it feels like working. Cannot hold network. The phone company has done all they can and it comes down to the device which is faulty. $600 plus down the drain.

The seller conveyed that they are only in a position to repair the phone instead of replacing it based on the 90 day warranty which I find very unfair because I have only used this phone for approximately 2 month! The phone was delivered in the You.S on the 19th of September . 2020 and I only got it sent to me in Jamaica in the month of November... Amazon has promised to address the matter so that I can get a proper redress because it would only be fair for me to get a a proper refund or proper replacement since the phone is not working properly. I await amazon’s feedback.

Phone proximity sensor defective!. the phone is nice and as described, but i am so mad because the sensor is not working, nor the auto-rotate, nor the iris scanner! I am an international buyer and i must commend amazon for suggesting a return but it is not fair by the seller that I will have to cover the charges by myself AND IT IS NOT MY FAULT!
Not as advertised. This phone was not AT&T. It also had a glitch in the speaker. Sent it back. The supplier was very good to refund but phone was not as advertised.

samsung galaxy note 8. this phone has a lot of problems. dropping calls, not staying except for a few hours, shutting down without me turning it off and it does not meet my expectation and I would appreciate a shipping label and full refund amount that I paid. this is about 8th time that I have been sending feedback about this phone and have got no reply about. I do not want this phone. All I need is a shipping label and a full refund of my monies paid asap. thanks in advance. victor

Careful which Seller. Hybrid IT was the seller. Beware. Stylus too thick to fit slot. Not original stylus, photo shows "Apple". Amazon has removed the seller, Hybrid IT on my return information. Battery had a problem... despite closing all apps & programs, battery went from 100% to 38% overnight. Refund has been prompt... Amazon fullfilled. May have to try Ebay... I do not like Amazon changing info.
Poor customer service. The touch doesn’t work on the phone... I can’t reship and I’m not entitled to a refund... set of rip off... I’m so mad $600 is a lot of money kmt

Buy New or Refurbished directly from Samsung. The phone is good. However, i had an issue with the bluetooth connecting. I also had an issue with sending and receiving basic emojis. Online support is not very helpful amd since it was a third party seller-I'd have to wait for service. I'm just going to factory reset and return. I'll order a different device. Hopefully Samaung will issue an update soon. Also, this device did not come with a Samsung charger-it came with a third party white cord and a black off brand base... nor does it come with the key to open the sim holder. I had to use an earring. Update:The vendor sent a replacement device but it was locked to Verizon-so it was useless. Talked to Amazon and I've been waiting for a refund to be issued to get anreplacement for the replacement and I'm stuck waiting. Do yourself a favor and order new elsewhere.

Great phone, shady sustomer service.. Excellent phone but came with a broken stylus. I contacted the seller and they said they would ship a replacement but never did. Bot a deal breaker but not cool at all.

Phone was broken. The phone did not work. The internal speaker was busted and it got stuck on a boot up screen when attempting a normal reset to send the phone back. I would recommend a different seller.

Buyers Beware. It's a very nice phone, one of the best on the market right now. But, having said that I must add a 'Buyers Beware' warning: pay attention to the Seller's/Vendor's standings on honesty. Review all the low, 1 and 2 stars ratings so you won't get burned. They often advertise their phones under "Prime" Amazon labels as 'new', but in reality a lot of those phones are used, refurbished second hand phones. That's what I went through just recently in July. Had to return a 'new' phone which failed Google integrity test and was previously registered for warranty in Dec. 2017. So, before you open the box, check the IMEI on line to learn about your new phone. The Imei# is listed outside, on the box.

Not sure phone was new! Buyer Beware!!!. Yikes! Gifted this to my son. Truly shocked that package containing phone had clearly been opened as well as brochure with instructions was missing. Son was unwilling to return as he was in need of phone. Buyer beware!
No refund month out. internet doesn't work when wi-fi off for straight talk. was not a LTE/CDMA, can'tm use internet. Return approved, shipped over a month ago still no refund issued

Sending out FAULTY Phones. I received this phone on Christmas Eve. Exactly two months later, I was in a different city on the high to get back home using the GPS and my phone completely shut off. It was charged and had plenty of juice left. It would not turn on. I had to get off the highway and wait for almost two hours for it to turn back on to be able to get back home. Thereafter, it began shutting off randomly while it would be charging, using the charger that came with the device. To this day, I am having the same exact issues and tech support is NO help. never again.

Poor quality control, charging cord/phone connection failty. I received my "renewed" note 8 from this company only to get a charging error immediately upon arrival. The cord and phone had a faulty connection and would not charge, charging cord was of poor quality and was not a fast charger as is supplied with all new Samsung phones. Even when I replaced the cord with one of my own I got an error indicating there was also a problem inside the phone at the charging connection. This device was supposed to be "inspected and tested" with the renewed phone process yet I still received a defective product.

Go with another seller. I don't like to write negative reviews but I should Express how I feel about this phone. It doesn't seem "renewed". It was dirty, had huge scratches around the charger port and the battery is about 1 to 2 hours at best. The phone works but I paid 40 more for blue from this seller and the cheaper note 8 was in perfect condition. I would recommend another seller like Stonkss
